questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Kei or Warriors?
At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
How many 100+ scores separate the all-time #1 (Tazmin Brits) and #2 (Cri-Zelda Brits) century-makers (T20)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits: 2 — Cri-Zelda Brits: 1 — a gap of 1.

questions.question: "Badgers" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: South Western Districts was rebranded Badgers.

questions.question: At which ground did Fay Cowling record their career-best bowling figures (4-38, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Wanderers, against Badgers on 2024/10/19.

questions.question: At which ground did Dragons record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — largest win by runs of 331, against Boland on 2019/02/02.
